items.title: Target (TGT) Looks Fairly Valued As Roundel Growth Lifts Earnings Hopes
items.summary: Target (TGT) is back in focus after its Roundel retail media unit reported nearly 20% year over year growth, lifting higher margin advertising income and feeding into improved expectations for earnings and a stronger operating outlook. The recent excitement around Roundel arrives after a sharp run in Target’s share price, with a year to date share price return of 55.47% and a 1 year total shareholder return of 84.11%. The 30 day share price return of 8.02% shows some cooling in the near term...
